Record Class HoodHoming.Params

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
frc.robot.subsystems.hood.HoodHoming.Params
Record Components:
stopDeg - hood angle at the bottom stop, degrees
volts - output while homing, toward the stop (negative)
stallDegPerSec - the hood is stalled while slower than this, deg/s
stallSeconds - how long it must stay stalled to count as on the stop
timeoutSeconds - how long an attempt may run before giving up
nearHomeDeg - re-home on stow once this close to the stop, degrees
Enclosing class:
HoodHoming

  • Method Details

    • fm

      public static HoodHoming.Params fm()
      FM's numbers. CALIBRATE on the bench (README, "Hood homing").
      • Stop 9 deg: the angle FM's code has always seeded at boot and sent home to.
      • -1.5 V: about 0.6 V goes to the 25 A kS (Kraken FOC is about 0.025 ohm), the rest moves the hood at roughly 50 deg/s, so the 40 deg of travel takes under a second. Stalled, the 60 A stator limit caps the push. 6328 homes at -2 V.
      • Stalled under 4 deg/s for 0.2 s: 4 deg/s is a tenth of the homing speed, and 0.2 s covers the hood breaking away from rest and the velocity signal's lag, so a hood that starts above the stop is not taken as stalled before it moves.
      • Timeout 3 s: three times the full-travel time.
      • Re-home on stow within 2 deg: a stow re-home then corrects at most a couple of degrees, and costs about 0.25 s at the stop.
      Returns:
      the constants
